question: Δ ABC ∼ Δ PQR, AB = 12 cm, PQ = 18 cm, and perimeter of Δ ABC is 45 cm. Find the perimeter of Δ PQR.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **similar triangles**, the ratio of their **perimeters** is equal to the ratio of their **corresponding sides**.

Ratio of sides **AB : PQ** = 12 : 18 = 2 : 3.

Let the perimeter of **Δ PQR** be x.

⇒ 45 / x = 2 / 3

⇒ x = (45 × 3) ÷ 2 = 67.5 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 67.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Δ ABC ∼ Δ PQR, **AB** = 12 cm, **PQ** = 18 cm, and **Perimeter(Δ ABC)** = 45 cm.

**Formula Used:**

If two triangles are **similar**, then the ratio of their perimeters is equal to the ratio of their **corresponding sides**: 
 Perimeter(Δ ABC) ÷ Perimeter(Δ PQR) = AB ÷ PQ = BC ÷ QR = AC ÷ PR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df8e9a6b92f3a7a2a71ab2da88ba891062e77f71f084d64352ce18eab9977b68.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the perimeter of **Δ PQR** be **P₂**.

⇒ 45 ÷ P₂ = 12 ÷ 18

⇒ 45 ÷ P₂ = 2 ÷ 3

⇒ 2 × P₂ = 45 × 3

⇒ 2 × P₂ = 135

⇒ P₂ = 135 ÷ 2

⇒ P₂ = 67.5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 67.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Similar Triangles

If Δ ABC ∼ Δ PQR, then the ratio of their corresponding altitudes, medians, and angle bisectors is also equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Ratio of Areas

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides: Area(Δ ABC) ÷ Area(Δ PQR) = (AB ÷ PQ)².

AA Similarity Criterion

If two angles of one triangle are respectively equal to two angles of another triangle, then the two triangles are similar (Angle-Angle Similarity).</p
